items.title: Conditional commitments: intends_to_deliver claim + paused task + triggers + reassess/resume/abandon; minimal packet; always_yield through the policy slot; P0.3 tests
items.brief: loom/src/trajectory/commitments.cpp + policy.h (slot interface: Policy::decide(stream, event) -> Decision with all candidates; this item ships only always_yield; T-K5 adds the rest). On a defer decision: Claim intends_to_deliver (subject = agent actor entity, object = content_segment entity for the undelivered remainder, qualifiers.valid_to from data deadline ('' = none), qualifiers.extra {trigger, conditions[], reassess_before_execute: true, decision_id}, assessment.open.questions = condition labels, status Active) written through a MINIMAL GraphPacket (packet::execute make -> empty_diff -> apply -> GraphPacketStore accept; records: Source sha256 of the closed segment, Unit event_stream, the interrupt Observation (kind Utterance, attrs.event_kind/event_i/time/positions), the segment and actor Entities, the Decision, the claim) — T-K4 generalises the same builder. TaskEngine task kind trajectory.deferred (params {conv_id, claim_id, segment_id}, dedupe true) moved to paused via pause(); handler registered in Runtime: ON ENTRY it checks whether its trigger fired; if not it returns Errc::Paused immediately (so recover_interrupted's running -> pending never executes a reassess); when fired it reassesses and returns Paused again unless a delivery/abandon decision was taken. Triggers from settings trajectory_reassess_triggers: user_turn_end (bus kMsgCreated role user), silence_at_least {t: int64, unit} (injected clock), goal_mentioned (lexical match of the goal label), explicit_resume. reassess(claim): still_relevant (goal claim active), still_urgent (valid_to not passed per stream clock), user_did_not_cancel (no cancel event referencing the intention), extra conditions from data -> new Decision {deliver_proposal | keep_waiting | abandon} citing condition results as premises/counter; deliver_proposal emits an action proposal message (existing ActionProposalBlock path, metadata.action_proposal, title from words, cost line from use_model estimate or 'nieznany' with reason, do_not_propose honoured) whose 'yes' runs trajectory.resume; abandon supersedes the claim and cancels the task — content never deleted. Actions: trajectory.reassess {conv_id, intention?}, trajectory.resume {conv_id, intention} (composite: reassess, then use_model continuation with the deferred segment + original user message; effects costs_money), trajectory.abandon with rule confirm:trajectory.abandon (scope app_preset, initiator application preset, reason pl/en) in action_rules.pack; trajectory.show {conv_id, lang, filter?} (view schema loom.trajectory_view/1, every int64 also as *_text). Phrases 'wznow odlozone', 'porzuc odlozone', 'co odlozyles'. Tests (fixtures from T-A1): (1) replan after new fact: new_fact contradicting the premise -> earlier decision superseded_by the new one whose counter cites the fact's observation; (2) invalidate stale goal: goal_change -> goal claim valid_to set, intention abandoned with reason goal_superseded, segment still present; (3) return to important matter: user_turn_end -> reassess -> deliver_proposal; after 'yes' a delivered claim with positions and the task done; (4) crash: task left running -> recover_interrupted -> pending -> handler returns Paused without reassessing (trigger not fired); after the trigger, reassess works; (5) 'no' repeated until guardian.pack kinds.proposal_rejection.suppress_at (read from the pack, never a literal) suppresses the next proposal; (6) reassess never executes the old decision without re-evaluating (a changed condition flips the outcome); (7) abandon leaves the content segment readable.

items.title: Live hook: interrupted streaming reply -> in-memory queue -> background EventLog + trajectory.build -> deferred intention -> proposal on next turn end; web sends displayed_chars
items.brief: In ChatEngine::send (loom/src/chat/chat_engine.cpp, the cancellation branch persisting partial text with metadata.cancelled) when trajectory_live (scope chain) != off: push the interrupt event (i from a per-conversation counter, t = unix us, actor model:<id>, positions.generated = codepoints of partial text, positions.played = displayed_chars from the new optional wire field ChatOptions.client_state {displayed_chars} sent with the cancel request, else {unknown: no_client_report}, heard_estimated = {unknown: no_estimator} until T-K5) and utterance events for user/assistant messages into TrajectoryInbox (mutex + vector, in process) and notify a background drain thread; NO database write in the send thread (EventLog::append is a DB write — provenance.h:158). The drain thread appends EventLog type trajectory:event (subject conv_id) and submits TaskEngine task trajectory.build {conv_id} (dedupe) which folds events into the open segment, closes segments at packet.segment_events, and — when the chosen turn_policy decides defer for the interrupt — creates the deferred intention (T-K2); record_only records without proposals. Setting trajectory_live_flush: background (preset) | inline (durable, one write in the send path; the owner chooses); known loss documented in data (words). proposal_rejected via Guardian::note_rejection. Web: the stop button sends displayed_chars with the cancel (loom/web/src/components/ChatView.tsx cancelStreaming path, counts rendered codepoints of the partial reply); Android JNI path in T-A2 (until then unknown with reason). Settings trajectory_live, trajectory_live_flush, turn_policy, trajectory_reassess_triggers gain readers (status planned removed; human.flows updated; check_action_reads passes). Tests (test_chat_engine / test_trajectory_live with ScriptedTransport): cancel mid-stream -> inbox has the interrupt; a DB write counter on the send thread stays 0 with the hook on; after drain EventLog has it with generated != played (displayed_chars given) or played unknown; next user message -> a proposal message exists with a cost line (money from registry or 'nieznany' with reason); 'yes' -> continuation request body contains the deferred segment reference and the original user text (golden); 'no' -> guardian proposal_rejection recorded; trajectory_live = off -> no events, byte-identical send (golden request unchanged); inline flush -> event durable before send returns.

items.title: Full packet: closed hashed segments, METHOD_GRAPH records, CAS accept, deterministic replay; trajectory.record / replay / state (P0.4)
items.brief: loom/src/trajectory/packet.cpp generalises T-K2's builder with the existing constructors only (packet::execute make -> empty_diff -> apply; never a new packet type): per CLOSED segment one Source (sha256 of the segment bytes, retained as sources capture; prev_sha256 chain checked), one Unit (kind event_stream), one Observation per event (kind Utterance; attrs.event_kind, event_i int64, time {t, t_end, unit, rate, epoch} int64, positions, channels; locator json_pointer /events/<n>; Locator.time_start/time_end double seconds display only; ordinal = n within the segment, int; speaker = actor ref), Entities: trajectory (canonical_key = stream_id), actors (existing ids reused when the ref is a known entity/address, else Entity with open kind from the stream's class), goals from goal_change/new_fact events and the conversation's active task spec, content_segment for assistant utterances; Claims with real subject/predicate/object and Assessments (observed with Support quotes; derived with Derivation op trajectory.derive/1); segment_of claims link segments so history replay stays bounded. METHOD_GRAPH: method identity trajectory.replay, method version with definition_sha256 (pack section hash + code version), parameter-set version, run entity with input identity = segment sha256; result claims produced_in_run. Persist via KnowledgeStore run kr_trajectory:<stream_id>/<segment> and GraphPacketStore::execute({accept, expected_rows}). trajectory.replay {conv_id|stream} rebuilds from the same segments and calls store replay -> {packet_ids[], identical: bool, drift[]}. trajectory.record {conv_id|stream, policy?} closes the open segment on request (writes, local, money 0). trajectory.state {actor?, goal?, window? {t_from, t_to, unit}, modality?, perspective?, lang} (P0.4): returns the state claims whose qualifiers match (valid_from/to, scope, attrs.modality text|audio|video|simulated) — no audio required; empty result says why. Tests: same segment + same pack hash -> same packet id and byte-identical encode (I5); accept twice idempotent (CAS); store restart then replay verifies rows; tampered row -> drift reported, never repaired; dangling provenance refused; 3-actor fixture -> N participates_as claims with scope; attrs.time int64 preserved after store round-trip; open segment has no packet id; closing at segment_events yields a new segment with prev_sha256; trajectory.state filters by window and actor.

items.title: Candidates, Q per dimension x horizon (basis points), explicit_rule, estimator slot, reading-rate operator; trajectory.assess / compare
items.brief: loom/src/trajectory/policy.cpp: assess(stream, up_to_event, policy, budget) -> for each decision point (events whose kind has decision_point: true in data: interrupt, overlap_start, user_turn_end with pending intention, new_fact, goal_change) build candidates from actions x applicable horizons; values per (dim, horizon) as {value_bp: int 0..10000, basis: rule|heuristic|estimator, calibrated: false} stored in DecisionAlternative.value.q (ValueImpact effects only map principles from philosophy/principles.json) — integer arithmetic only (bit-stable x86/arm64); the chosen alternative plus choice {method} in the record; attrs.mode shadow|live|simulated. Policies read from trajectory.pack: always_yield (from T-K2); explicit_rule with conditions evaluated by a CLOSED op set in code (event_is, interrupt_kind_is, remaining_priority_at_least, interruption_shorter_than, pending_intention, conditions_hold, text_matches_cues) — the validator refuses unknown ops; estimator resolves the model through annotations::resolve_model(cfg, root, 'turn_policy', conv, ...) (annotation_layer.h:143) -> without a model returns unavailable {reason: no_estimator} and falls back to data estimator.fallback (preset explicit_rule), recorded in the trace; with a model it goes through llm::use_model (x10 guard, limits, money_format) with the prompt registered as a METHOD_GRAPH prompt version; estimator numbers are claims with origin model_knowledge, measurement_status unavailable, rounded to basis points on receipt. heard_estimated for interrupt events now filled by a local reading-rate operator trajectory.reading_rate/1 (derived, confidence from data). Decision latency measured with a monotonic clock (int64 us) and stored in the run. compare(stream, policies[]) -> per policy: decisions, retained_urgent_info (deferred segments with priority >= data threshold later delivered / total), unwanted_persistence (continue chosen while user events say cancel), decision_latency_us {p50, p95}, cost {money text via format_money, calls}, measurement_status unavailable for human-rated metrics; no 'better' field. Actions trajectory.assess {conv_id|stream, policy?, until_event?}, trajectory.compare {conv_id|stream, policies?} (http, phrases 'ocen te rozmowe polityka …', 'porownaj polityki tury', reads [turn_policy, turn_policy_estimator_model], coverage). Ports role turn_policy.estimate -> partial (reader: policy.cpp); settings status planned removed. Tests: interrupt_mid_word.json always_yield -> yield+defer; explicit_rule + backchannel -> continue; high-priority remainder -> brief_clarification; estimator without model -> unavailable reason + fallback recorded, never a fabricated number; ScriptedTransport estimator reply -> claims carry model_knowledge and measurement_status unavailable; compare has no 'better' field, money '0' for local, 'unknown' without price; same input -> same decision ids; no floating-point in the rule evaluator (grep test on policy.cpp for double in Q arithmetic).

items.title: Metadiagnostics from the first decision: competing hypotheses, support/counter, proposed tests, budget-aware; trajectory.diagnose / judge
items.brief: loom/src/trajectory/diagnose.cpp: diagnose(packet, since_decision, budget) runs after EVERY decision (no count threshold anywhere; grep-test that diagnose.cpp and trajectory.pack contain no literal gate on repeat counts). Templates from trajectory.pack hypotheses (+ user overlay): situation (which decision/result pattern instantiates it), supports_if / contradicts_if (closed op set of T-K5), confirm_if / refute_if texts naming the next observations, experiment (an extrapolated proposal). Output: Entities hypothesis + Claims inferred (ExpectedProperty with a closed predicate from kb::kPredicates, rationale from data), Support from observations, Counter from contradicting ones, confidence from a likelihood table in data (calibrated: false, stated), attrs.repeat_count (int64) as a feature; competing hypotheses coexist (I7), never merged; experiments as extrapolated claims (never premises, I3). Budget: local = always and free; local_and_estimator additionally asks the estimator model over the SAME templates (dated evaluation claim, measurement_status unavailable, cost shown) only when a model is set; off = record diagnosis_skipped {reason: budget_off} on the decision. Guardian thresholds (guardian.pack:94-98) are used ONLY by a later, separate promotion step (guardian.promote after the owner's judgement) — never to gate hypothesis generation. The operator is generic: input = any sequence of (decision, result) pairs; interface documented so tool runs, context loss and the duplex simulator can feed it. trajectory.judge {hypothesis, verdict: confirmed|rejected, note?} appends a model::Judgement (KnowledgeStore add_judgement; replayed on rebuild, I4) — the ONLY way a hypothesis changes status. Actions with http/phrases ('co moze byc nie tak', 'to trafne' / 'to nietrafne'), reads [trajectory_diagnosis_budget, turn_policy_estimator_model], coverage. Tests: a single deferral yields >= 2 competing hypotheses with distinct confirm_if; two deferrals of the same segment raise repeat_count and weights without any gate; budget off records diagnosis_skipped; estimator path without model -> explicit reason; a judgement survives clear_run + rebuild; no hypothesis has evidence class observed; a synthetic non-voice (tool-run) decision sequence is accepted.
items.owner_sees: Chat: 'co moze byc nie tak' lists competing hypotheses with confidence, evidence and 'co by to potwierdzilo'; 'to trafne' / 'to nietrafne' records the judgement and the list reflects it immediately; the screen's 'Co moze byc nie tak' section with Trafne/Nietrafne buttons.

items.title: LLM intervention plan as claims (per-segment priority, predicted interruptions) in the graph reply flow — contract + synthetic fixture, status calibration, reply_plan preset off
items.brief: Extend the graph-reply contract (ChatOptions.flow graph, guardian.pack context_io.flows; packet::compile_reply keeps model attrs as draft) with OPTIONAL per-node attrs priority {value_bp, basis: proposal}, may_be_interrupted_by [{kind, basis_refs}], depends_on [local ids], open_conditions [text]; the flow's system instruction text (data, METHOD_GRAPH prompt version with text_sha256) asks for them only when setting reply_plan is on (preset off — golden request bytes stay identical). loom/src/trajectory/plan.cpp reads a compiled reply (reply_fragment for spans) into Claims: has_priority (literal, origin model_knowledge, calibrated: false), predicts_intervention -> model::Prediction (situation = segment local id; evaluated later against events; NotApplicable with reason intervention_changed_conditions when a reorder/front_load decision changed the conditions), depends_on claims between segments, open_conditions -> assessment.open. T-K5's explicit_rule uses has_priority when present (chip 'priorytet: z planu modelu (nieskalibrowany)') else lexical cues (chip 'z reguly slow'). Fixture: synthetic model reply with the attrs (reply-fixtures.json pattern, zero provider calls). Tests: compile + plan -> N has_priority claims with model_knowledge; prediction evaluated against a later interrupt at that segment -> Holds; after a reorder decision -> NotApplicable with reason; reply_plan off -> request bytes unchanged (golden); calibration entry listed under Eksperymenty i kalibracja.
items.owner_sees: Ustawienia > Rozmowa > 'Plan odpowiedzi od modelu' (preset wylaczony, chip kalibracja); when on and the flow is graph, decision rows say 'priorytet: z planu modelu (nieskalibrowany)' and predicted interruptions appear on the timeline as hypotheses with their later outcome.

items.title: Full-duplex controller core: independent channel state machines, commands as events, cut mid-unit with fade, playback rate num/den, context sync from P_played
items.brief: loom/include/loom/duplex.h + loom/src/duplex/controller.cpp: Channel {name, version (int64), position (int64, unit of the stream time_base), state} for capture, generation (CancelToken + streaming on_chunk of ChatEngine), synthesis, playback, conversation_memory; Controller::on_event(DialogueEvent) -> commands {generation.cancel, synthesis.cancel, playback.cut {fade_us}, playback.rate {num, den}, capture.mark} appended to the SAME stream as events of kind command (so replay reproduces every decision); the policy is the T-K5 slot (always_yield until K5); the undelivered remainder (generated minus played) becomes a deferred intention through T-K2; conversation_memory is told only what P_played covers (heard_estimated stays a hypothesis). Cut takes effect at the next frame boundary (frame_us from data); rate changes the mapping position -> time (integer num/den, no floating point). Latency per decision measured (int64 us, monotonic) and stored in the run. Explicit degraded paths (P1.5): no synthesis adapter -> text mode, same stream; no estimator -> fallback recorded; transport error -> event error, never silence; no audio device declared (client_devices.h) -> capture channel absent with reason. Tests with the simulator: interrupt mid-word -> playback.cut at the next frame, positions ordered, remainder deferred; rate 3/2 -> P_played advances 1.5x per frame; replay of events+commands byte-identical; every degraded path yields an explicit event; 0 network calls from the controller (counter).
items.owner_sees: Chat: the simulation table now includes the controller's commands (ciecie po 10 ms, tempo 3/2) and the deferred remainder appears in 'co odlozyles'; nothing audible yet.

items.title: Web audio loop: browser speechSynthesis as a zero-cost speech.synthesize adapter (word boundaries -> P_played), local energy VAD, continuous capture with consent, duplex_voice_loop preset off
items.brief: ports.pack: adapter browser_speech for role speech.synthesize (cost known 0, capabilities as data: boundary_events, cancel, rate_change: unknown until measured). loom/web/src/duplex/: speak the streaming reply through window.speechSynthesis (chunked by sentence as it streams), onboundary -> P_played in codepoints (word granularity) reported to the kernel as playback position events via the client device path (P13); cancel() cuts (browsers may not fade — recorded honestly as fade_us: 0); local VAD (energy threshold and hangover as data in duplex.pack) over continuous microphone capture (client device with consent each session, never in the background) -> overlap_start event; the kernel controller (D-K2) decides, the web executes commands; the interrupt event lands in the live stream of T-K3 with real positions, so the remainder becomes a deferred intention and the proposal appears. Setting duplex_voice_loop (off preset | on) with human text; Android WebView: feature-detect speechSynthesis and boundary events; when absent -> 'niedostepne: powod' and P_played at segment level with reason (H6 measured in T-A2's emulator profiles). Tests: headless with a fake speechSynthesis (boundary events scripted): positions ordered, cut on VAD, interrupt event carries word-level played; e2e at 390 px with the scripted server: reply spoken (fake), overlap -> cut -> strip 'Odlozone (1)' -> proposal; no network call from the loop (counter); setting off -> no microphone request (asserted).

items.title: Voice as functions of time: local DSP tool (python -I, numpy) -> loom.voice_features/1 -> measured.* claims; voice.analyse from chat; network as a setting (preset off); psychological-predicate test
items.brief: loom/tools/voice/ (python -I, numpy only in the preset; feature list as data in loom/data/runtime/voice.pack: f0 (autocorrelation/YIN), jitter, shimmer, hnr, formants f1-f3 (LPC), mfcc, energy, speech_rate (from transcript when present), pauses, breath_gaps (pause positions relative to syntactic boundaries from the transcript — the owner's statement 5), rhythm over time; frame_ms and hop as data). Output loom.voice_features/1 with time_base {unit: samples, rate: int64} and int64 frame indices; stored as claims predicate measured.<feature> (evidence derived, method voice.dsp/<version> with definition hash) in a GraphPacket over the recording source (sha256, retained per setting voice_raw_retention: keep | features_only, preset keep, human text). Action voice.analyse {attachment|recording, lang} (local, money 0, phrases 'przeanalizuj ten glos', 'pokaz cechy glosu') + chat_coverage; CLI = thin wrapper. Tests: synthetic signal (tone with known F0 + modulation + silences) -> F0 within tolerance from data, pauses found at the known positions; time_base preserved; grep/structural test: no claim produced by the tool has a predicate from psychological_predicates with origin != user; network off -> blocked event; features_only retention removes the raw file after the packet is accepted.
